pains.title: You want to live healthier, but…
items: Busy mornings mean you often grab something quick or skip breakfast?
You get hungry mid-morning but don't know what's convenient and still a better choice?
You're used to soft drinks, milk tea or other sugary drinks?
You want to eat better, but there are too many rules and you don't know where to start?
You've tried to change many times, but it's hard to stick with because everything feels too complicated?
pains.callout:
You don't need to start with a strict diet.
Start with small choices you can make right away in your everyday life.

sections.title: Suggested use over 10 days
items: **On busy mornings:** mix 1 sachet of VitaGreen Nutritious Meal instead of a rushed breakfast.
**When you're hungry mid-morning:** have Seed Nutrition with Curcumin as a ready-made snack.
**When you crave a sweet drink:** mix 1 sachet of DILVANG Tea with 300–400ml of warm water.
You don't need to use all 3 products every day – pick the moments that fit your routine. See the package or each product page for preparation instructions.

sections.title: Who it's for
items: Busy people who often rush breakfast or skip it.
People who want to cut back on soft drinks, milk tea and sugary drinks.
People who want to try all 3 product lines before choosing a large box.

sections.title: Please note
sections.text: This pack helps you start building healthier eating habits; the amount of product in the pack is not your entire diet for 10 days. If you are taking medication, pregnant or breastfeeding, please consult your doctor before use.

disclaimer: VitaGreen Nutritious Meal and Seed Nutrition with Curcumin are dietary supplements. This product is not a medicine and does not replace medical treatment.
